actors.name: Parliamentary Transport Committee
actors.private_context: The committee is responsible for reviewing transport-related legislation. Its rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The committee has discretion over scheduling and may consider political factors, workload, and public interest.

shared_context: The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee has received the rail franchise bill for consideration. The bill has been formally referred to the committee, triggering a sixty-day window within which the committee may schedule a public hearing. The committee's rules do not mandate a hearing but permit one to be scheduled within that period.

starting_events.description: The rail franchise bill is referred to the parliamentary transport committee, starting the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the parliamentary transport committee actually scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill before 2026-09-30T09:00:00+03:00 (sixty days after referral). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00.
